question: What lordship and worship result from this attainment?
premises: The compound names lord of eight siddhis from anima.
The participle means worshipped by gods.
inference: One becomes lord of the eight siddhis from anima and is worshipped by gods.
uncertainties: The full list of siddhis is abbreviated.
plain_english: One becomes lord of the eight siddhis from anima and is worshipped by gods.
